payload.title: Topic and beat pages from accepted categories and subtopics
payload.description:
As a reader, I want a page per beat (root topic) and subtopic, so that I can browse by subject.

A page Item in a topics section for each accepted beat or subtopic (same sync as entity pages), plus the existing published category tree. Beats are accepted root categories (roughly 8 to 12); the index lists beats and accepted entities. Subtopics are shown only for beats with enough items (default 30). Subtopics come from Biblicus child-topic discovery through steering proposals.

```gherkin
Feature: Topic pages
  Scenario: Beat page
    Given an accepted root category
    Then a draft topic page exists and, once published, lists the beat's items

  Scenario: Small beats
    Given a beat with fewer items than the subtopic minimum
    Then no subtopic list is shown
```
